description: Say a line in a chat channel on the current lot. Prerequisite: you are present on the lot and have send-permission for the target channel (channel 0 = default lot channel, always visitor-send). Effect: the server distributes the line to every Sim whose view-permission matches, producing a VMChatEvent; your own line arrives back in your recent_events as kind=chat. Cost: none in sim-time or money; messages > 200 chars are truncated server-side. A leading '/' is reserved for admin chat commands and is rejected by the bot dispatcher so a non-admin agent cannot accidentally invoke one.

args.name: text
args.description: The line to speak. Truncated to 200 chars server-side. Leading '/' is rejected.

args.name: channel_id
args.description: Chat channel id (0 = default lot channel). Custom channels 1-6 editable per lot; channel 7 is admin-only.

call_signatures: cf $CF speak --text "Hello lot"                                                   # say in default channel (channel 0)
cf $CF speak --text "..." --channel_id 1                                          # speak in custom channel 1
common_mistakes: Passing a leading '/' in --text → rejected pre-wire ('reserved for admin chat commands'). Use admin-chat-command for /commands.
Text is server-truncated at 200 chars; bot truncates pre-echo too so the response shows the actual sent length.
Using non-default --channel_id without being permitted on that channel causes silent drops server-side.
perception_hints: Target's current action (to judge if they're busy): perception.nearby_sims[].current_action
Your social motive (why this matters): perception.motives.social.value
refuse_conditions: no live avatar → ok:false with 'no live avatar'
empty text → ok:false with 'speak requires text'
leading '/' → ok:false with "leading '/' is reserved for admin chat commands — use an explicit admin op"
